title: Spent $3,000 on coins, made it back, then bought more
description: Mom finds Nate spent $2,000 (actually three) on coins and gives him one week to make every dollar back; after days of nothing and a night of doubt the charts turn green on fomo, Mom joins in to show him how it's done, and he hits a six-figure balance. The reselling becomes trading on fomo, the live-action tag becomes Nate's fomo line. Unlike the other two, Nate cheekily admits it was three thousand, the turn is a wordless star jump ('Yo.' 'Yeah!') instead of running to Mom with the count, and it ends on Mom catching him buying more ('Maybe.').
text:
SCENE 1 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — AFTERNOON
From behind Nate at his desk: Mom storms through the doorway waving his empty wallet.
MOM: Nate! Where is all your money?
NATE: What?
Mom lunges to the desk and slams the wallet down.
MOM: You had $2,000.
Nate jumps up and shrugs.
NATE: I spent it.
MOM: On what?
NATE: My business.
Whip into a high-angle wide: Nate proudly spreads his arms over his set-up, phone stands, an old laptop, chart sketches on every wall; Mom aghast.
MOM: You spent $2,000 on coins?
Nate, phone in hand, raises his eyebrows.
NATE: Actually, three.
Close-up on Mom: eyes bulging, teeth bared.
MOM: Three?!
NATE: I just started.
NATE: Yes.
Mom throws her hands up and slams the desk; Nate holds up his phone.
MOM: You spent $2,000.
NATE: And I'm going to make it back.
MOM: Then prove it.
NATE: How?
Slow push in as Mom points her finger.
MOM: One week. Make your $2,000 back.
Extreme close-up two-shot in profile, nose to nose.
NATE: All of it?
MOM: Every dollar.
SCENE 2 — MONTAGE — NATE'S BEDROOM — DAY
Locked-off frame across the desk, jump cuts: Nate sketches a chart on a sticky note and slaps it on the wall.
Nate sets price alerts on his phone, then another, then another.
Nate leans into the old laptop, taking notes.
Nate taps buy and stares at his phone, eyes wide.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, the line flat and red, the position reads $0.00
Nate shuts the laptop, deflated.
SCENE 3 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
Nate behind the laptop in the dark, hair messy, no cap; Mom appears in the lit doorway behind him.
NATE: I spent everything.
Mom leans on the door frame and speaks softly.
MOM: You don't have to prove anything to me.
NATE: Yes, I do.
NATE: I said I could do this.
His phone lights up on the desk beside the laptop.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the line turning green, the position reads +$64
NATE: Wait.
He turns to look back at Mom, then to camera, mouth falling open.
NATE: Mom.
Snap zoom: extreme close-up on Nate's face, the green chart glowing in his pupils, jaw dropping.
NATE: Yo.
Wide on the dark room: Nate sits frozen, then launches into a star jump behind the desk, fists up.
NATE: Yeah!
SCENE 4 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
Locked-off time-lapse: Nate trades at blurred speed on phone and laptop, appearing and vanishing, sticky notes multiplying on the wall.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $1,900
The door behind opens; Mom appears and gapes, hand on her head.
MOM: What happened?
NATE: They're climbing.
MOM: All of them?
NATE: I'm trying.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $3,100
SCENE 5 — MONTAGE — NATE'S BEDROOM — DAYS
The same locked-off desk frame, Nate tapping in fast motion as the light flips: warm day, blue night, warm day, cool overcast.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $8,700
Blue night: Nate rubs his eyes, cold noodles at his elbow, and keeps going.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $22,400
Warm day: Nate sticks yet another note to the wall, never leaving the chair.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $47,800
SCENE 6 — INT. NATE'S BEDROOM — AFTERNOON
The fast motion ramps to real time: Nate slumps and faceplants onto the desk beside his phone, then lifts his head, dazed.
Mom comes in from the right with a teasing smile and leans over him.
MOM: What are you doing?
She takes the phone from his hand.
MOM: You're doing it wrong.
Sped up: Nate and Mom side by side, both trading, both smiling.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Mom's phone, the balance reads $93,500
They stand; Nate flips his phone to camera.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $528,300
They high-five.
NATE: Told ya.
MOM: Don't get cocky.
Whip-pan to the desk: the old laptop lights up with a fresh buy.
★ fomo screen: Desktop trading — on Nate's laptop, a brand-new position just opened
Mom turns to Nate.
MOM: You bought more?
Nate smirks.
NATE: Huh.
Snap zoom: extreme close-up on Mom's horrified face.
NATE: Maybe.
Nate stands in his room, turns to camera, phone up.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $528,300
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
changed_lines: MOM: You spent $2,000 on clothes? → MOM: You spent $2,000 on coins?
NATE: They're selling. → NATE: They're climbing.

cast.description: Teen, slim, big glossy brown eyes, thick dark brows, curly black hair; backwards navy cap, plain oversized white tee, thin silver chain, dark joggers, white sneakers.
Mid-40s, warm light-brown skin, short chestnut bob, big brown eyes, heavy brows; beige button-up blouse, navy trousers. Plays big: bulging eyes and bared teeth, then a warm, teasing smile.
